title: Timeline of the Culture
subtitle: An interactive rendering based closely on The Culture Wiki timeline compilation.
calendar: Common Era (CE), where year 1 corresponds to year 1 in the Gregorian calendar used on Earth today.
method: Display text follows The Culture Wiki Timeline closely. startYear is only a machine-sort field for the interactive visualization; negative values represent BCE.

datingLegend.explicit: Directly dated in the supplied chronology or source apparatus.
datingLegend.inferred: Approximate date reconstructed from a relative interval.
datingLegend.local-calendar: Dated in an in-universe calendar without a unique CE conversion in the supplied material.
